text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the 1st Live has finally arrived—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Right, let's go as rehearsed earlier.
No extra smoke for the finale is fine. Yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Light Hello is giving final instructions to the on-site staff. Meanwhile...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Inhaaaale... Exhaaale...
Deeeeep inhaaaale... Exhaaale...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! All that's left is to sing for everyone on stage!
We did everything we needed to for today!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Even yesterday...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'll be doing a live show soon!
Please come watch, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Good morning, Falcon-san.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Morning, Bourbon-chan!
Make sure you come to my next concert, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Without fail." Does that mean
this is an order?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Right, right, Falco's special order☆
Please make it great!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Order acknowledged.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I called out to so many kids until the very end!
So this time for sure—...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: The song that everyone prepared for me.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...I want it to truly reach someone's heart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Smart Falcon's lips looked like
they were trembling just a little.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay, Falco can do this!
I'll hype everyone up and get them wanting to help out—"
choice_data_list: You don't have to try to hype things up all by yourself
You don't have to try to hype things up all by yourself, okay?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh? But...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fellow performers aren't found
only on the stage.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"We are in the wings,
and the audience is right before the stage."
choice_data_list: We just have to get everyone swept up into it!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...I see. After all, this live is meant
to ask everyone for their cooperation.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'll go ask everyone
to 'have fun together' too!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Alright then, I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... Allow me to observe first.
Let's see what you all manage to stir up in this concert.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
A-And, Suzuka-kun?
Suuuzuuukaaa-kuuuun!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...You don't have to shout so loudly.
I'm right here."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
As standoffish as ever, I see~
However, make sure not to look away
from what is about to unfold, alright?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Even faint electrical stimulation can activate the brain.
Will that stimulus lead to the desired reaction?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Does the piece we need truly exist?
First, we must confirm everything.
